title: PinFix - Visual Frontend Editing for Claude Code
description: PinFix is a dev-only browser overlay for Claude Code. Click any UI, describe a change, or use inspector controls to edit source with Vite, Webpack, or Rspack.
ogTitle: PinFix - Visual Frontend Editing for Claude Code
twitterTitle: PinFix - Visual Frontend Editing for Claude Code
twitterDescription: Click any UI and let Claude Code edit the exact source location behind it.
jsonLdDescription: A dev-only browser overlay for Claude Code-powered visual frontend editing.
heroTitle: Edit Frontend Pages Like Design Comments.
heroSubtitle: Click any UI, describe what you want to change, or adjust the design with inspector-style controls. PinFix sends Claude Code the exact source location and visual intent.
designDemoSubtitle: Tune visual details in the browser, then send Claude Code structured changes tied to the selected source element.
designPreviewDescription: Selected button inside a live app preview.
designResultNote: visual change sent to Claude Code
howSubtitle: Three steps from idea to implementation. No context switching required.
howStep1Description: Press Alt+Shift+Z to enter edit mode. Hover over any element - it highlights instantly. Click to place a pin.
howStep2Description: Type what you want to change, or use Adjust design for text, layout, spacing, size, color, border, and typography controls.
howStep3Description: Claude Code edits your source code directly. HMR applies the change instantly. Continue the conversation to refine.
featuresSubtitle: Everything you need for Claude Code-assisted visual development.
featureVisualDescription: Crosshair mode highlights every component. Click to pin - no need to search for file paths or line numbers.
featureDesignDescription: Inspector-style controls turn visual tweaks into structured context for Claude Code, including layout, spacing, size, color, border, text, and typography.
featureHmrDescription: Source code edits trigger Hot Module Replacement. See changes appear in under a second, no page refresh needed.
featureFrameworkDescription: Works with React, Vue, and any JSX/TSX component. Automatically traces source locations via build-time transforms.
featureZeroDescription: One plugin line in your build config. The channel server spawns and cleans up automatically.
featureDevDescription: Completely stripped in production builds. Zero runtime overhead, no bundle size impact for your users.
quickstartSubtitle: Up and running in under a minute.
stackSubtitle: First-class support for major bundlers and frameworks.
